note: Elan's Outpost class and race notes (written for the Outpost, in its own words). The official character creation text is NOT here: it is read from the player's own client (ChrClasses / ChrRaces). Entries with basis 'game' were written from the game's own text and the in-game data only.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.summary: The plain fighter: heavy armor, big weapons and rage that builds as you hit and get hit. A warrior can hold a boss in place for the group or deal heavy melee damage.
classes.history: Every army of Azeroth is built on warriors, from the soldiers of Stormwind and the shield wall of Ironforge to the orc grunts who crossed the Dark Portal. Many famous leaders started as warriors, and the trade is taught in every capital.

facts.label: Fights with
facts.value: Rage, which fills in combat and drains away outside it

facts.label: Stances
facts.value: Battle Stance from the start; Defensive Stance at 10 and Berserker Stance at 30 come from class quests

facts.label: Plays as
facts.value: Main tank in groups and raids, or melee damage

figures.name: Grommash Hellscream
figures.why: Chieftain of the Warsong clan, who died killing the demon Mannoroth

figures.name: Anduin Lothar
figures.why: The Lion of Azeroth, commander of the Alliance in the Second War

mentions: Warriors can wear plate from level 40 and can use almost every weapon type
Rage is lost slowly out of combat, so a warrior opens fights with Charge to start with some
Shields block much of the physical damage a tank takes

classes.name: Paladin
classes.summary: A holy warrior in plate who fights in melee and calls on the Light to heal, protect and punish. Paladins buff the whole group with blessings and auras.
classes.history: The paladins began after the Second War, when Archbishop Alonsus Faol chose warriors to be trained in the Light. Uther the Lightbringer led the first order, the Knights of the Silver Hand. The order broke during the Third War when Prince Arthas turned and killed Uther. Survivors now serve in Stormwind, Ironforge and the Argent Dawn, while the Scarlet Crusade twisted the cause into fanaticism.

facts.label: Order
facts.value: The Knights of the Silver Hand

facts.label: Plays as
facts.value: Healer, tank or melee damage; blessings and auras for the group

figures.name: Uther the Lightbringer
figures.why: First leader of the Silver Hand, killed by Arthas

figures.name: Tirion Fordring
figures.why: Exiled paladin of Hearthglen who spared an orc and lost his title for it

figures.name: Alexandros Mograine
figures.why: The Ashbringer, a hero of the Scourge war

mentions: Paladins can wear plate from level 40
A paladin gets a warhorse at 40 and can earn a charger through a long class quest at 60
Redemption, the resurrection spell, comes from a class quest

classes.name: Hunter
classes.summary: A ranged fighter with a bow or gun and a tamed beast at their side. Hunters track creatures, set traps and let their pet hold the enemy while they shoot.
classes.history: Hunters come from every wild corner of the world: night elf sentinels, dwarven mountaineers, orc and troll beast trackers and tauren braves. Their bond with animals is older than any kingdom, and many of them serve as scouts for their people.

facts.label: Fights with
facts.value: Mana, a ranged weapon and ammunition

facts.label: Pets
facts.value: A tamed beast from level 10, after a short class quest

facts.label: Plays as
facts.value: Ranged damage; pulling, crowd control with traps

figures.name: Rexxar
figures.why: Half-ogre beastmaster and champion of the Horde

mentions: Hunters wear leather at first and mail from level 40
A pet needs food and grows loyal over time; each beast family has its own abilities
Ammunition goes in a quiver or ammo pouch, which also makes the hunter shoot faster

classes.name: Rogue
classes.summary: A melee fighter in leather who works from the shadows. Rogues stealth up to a target, build combo points with quick strikes and spend them on finishing moves.
classes.history: Rogues serve as spies, thieves and assassins for whoever pays. In Stormwind they gather around SI:7, the kingdom's intelligence service, and the hidden Ravenholdt guild trains its own in the Alterac Mountains. Many Horde rogues came out of the orc clans' scouts and the Forsaken's agents.

facts.label: Fights with
facts.value: Energy, which refills quickly, and combo points

facts.label: Plays as
facts.value: Melee damage; stuns, Sap and Blind to control fights

figures.name: Mathias Shaw
figures.why: Spymaster of SI:7 in Stormwind

figures.name: Edwin VanCleef
figures.why: Leader of the Defias Brotherhood, met in the Deadmines

mentions: Poisons open up at level 20 through a class quest
Rogues can pick locks on chests and doors as their skill rises
Stealth makes the rogue the best choice for scouting ahead

classes.name: Priest
classes.summary: A caster in cloth who heals, shields and, in the shadow arts, deals damage over time. The priest is the classic healer of a group.
classes.history: Priests serve the Holy Light in the human and dwarven lands, Elune among the night elves, and darker faiths among the Forsaken and the trolls. The Church of the Holy Light in Stormwind trained many of the first paladins, and its archbishop still leads the faithful.

figures.name: Alonsus Faol
figures.why: Archbishop who founded the paladin order

figures.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
figures.why: High Priestess of Elune and leader of the night elves

mentions: Each race's priests learn one or two spells of their own (for example Fear Ward for dwarves and Starshards for night elves)
Power Word: Fortitude raises the stamina of the whole group
Shadowform is the last talent of the Shadow tree

classes.name: Shaman
classes.summary: A spiritual leader who calls on the elements. Shaman fight in melee or cast lightning, heal, and place totems that help the group.
classes.history: Shamanism is the old faith of the orcs, lost when their warlocks turned to demons and brought back by Thrall. The tauren and the trolls kept their own shamanic ways. Shaman speak with the spirits of earth, fire, water and air, and many of them guide their people as elders.

facts.label: Totems
facts.value: Earth, Fire, Water and Air totems, each opened by a class quest

facts.label: Plays as
facts.value: Healer, caster damage or melee damage

figures.name: Thrall
figures.why: Warchief of the Horde and a powerful shaman

figures.name: Drek'Thar
figures.why: Elder shaman of the Frostwolf clan

mentions: Shaman wear leather at first and mail from level 40
Totems work for the group around the shaman, so their place matters
Reincarnation lets a shaman come back to life without help

classes.name: Mage
classes.summary: A ranged caster in cloth who deals heavy damage with fire, frost and arcane spells. Mages also make food and water, open portals and turn enemies into sheep.
classes.history: The magi of the Eastern Kingdoms learned their craft from the high elves and gathered in Dalaran under the Kirin Tor. Dalaran was ruined in the Third War. Archmage Antonidas fell there, and his apprentice Jaina Proudmoore led many survivors to Theramore in Kalimdor.

facts.label: Plays as
facts.value: Ranged damage; Polymorph for crowd control

figures.name: Jaina Proudmoore
figures.why: Ruler of Theramore and a former student of Antonidas

figures.name: Antonidas
figures.why: Grand Magus of the Kirin Tor, killed in the fall of Dalaran

figures.name: Khadgar
figures.why: Apprentice of Medivh and a hero of the Second War

mentions: Conjured food and water save the group money and time
Teleports and portals to the capitals use runes bought from reagent vendors
Mages can wear only cloth

classes.name: Warlock
classes.summary: A caster in cloth who uses shadow and fire magic, curses and damage over time, and commands a summoned demon.
classes.history: Warlock magic came to the orcs through Gul'dan and the Shadow Council, who bargained with the Burning Legion and used fel power to drive the Horde to war. Warlocks are feared and distrusted, but they practise in secret in most cities, and the Burning Blade cult still serves the demons.

facts.label: Demons
facts.value: Imp first; Voidwalker, Succubus and Felhunter come from class quests

facts.label: Plays as
facts.value: Ranged damage; fear and pets for control

figures.name: Gul'dan
figures.why: The first orc warlock, who led the Shadow Council

mentions: A warlock gets a felsteed at level 40, and the dreadsteed is a long class quest at 60
Soul shards from Drain Soul are used to summon demons and make healthstones
Ritual of Summoning brings a party member to the warlock

classes.name: Druid
classes.summary: A shapeshifter who heals as a caster, tanks as a bear, fights as a cat and casts nature spells. One druid can fill almost any role.
classes.history: The druids are the oldest order of the night elves, taught by the demigod Cenarius. Malfurion Stormrage was the first, and most druids sleep in the Emerald Dream between wars. The tauren learned the way too, and both races meet in the Cenarion Circle at Moonglade.

facts.label: Fights with
facts.value: Mana as a caster, rage as a bear, energy as a cat

facts.label: Forms
facts.value: Bear at 10 and Aquatic at 16 by class quests; Cat at 20; Travel at 30

figures.name: Malfurion Stormrage
figures.why: The first druid, asleep in the Emerald Dream

figures.name: Fandral Staghelm
figures.why: Arch Druid in Darnassus

figures.name: Hamuul Runetotem
figures.why: Tauren arch druid of Thunder Bluff

mentions: Teleport: Moonglade takes a druid to the Cenarion Circle
Druids can wear only cloth and leather
Rebirth can bring an ally back to life in the middle of a fight

races.name: Human
races.summary: The most common race of the Eastern Kingdoms and the heart of the Alliance.
races.history: The humans built the kingdoms of Arathor, Stormwind and Lordaeron. The orcs razed Stormwind in the First War, the Alliance of Lordaeron pushed them back in the Second War, and in the Third War the Scourge destroyed Lordaeron itself. Stormwind, rebuilt, now leads the Alliance while its king is missing.

facts.label: Leader
facts.value: The boy king Anduin Wrynn, with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon as regent

figures.name: Anduin Wrynn
figures.why: Young king of Stormwind

figures.name: Bolvar Fordragon
figures.why: Highlord and regent of Stormwind

figures.name: Katrana Prestor
figures.why: Royal advisor at court; her true nature is a famous secret

mentions: King Varian Wrynn went missing on a voyage, which leaves the court in the hands of advisors
The Defias Brotherhood are stonemasons who were never paid for rebuilding Stormwind

races.name: Dwarf
races.summary: Stout miners, smiths and explorers from the mountains of Khaz Modan, and old allies of the humans.
races.history: The dwarves split into three clans after the War of the Three Hammers: the Bronzebeards stayed in Ironforge, the Wildhammers went to the Hinterlands and the Dark Irons to Blackrock Mountain. Discoveries in Uldaman showed that the titans made them, and the Explorers' League now digs all over the world for the rest of the story.

facts.label: Homeland
facts.value: Khaz Modan, in the Eastern Kingdoms

figures.name: Magni Bronzebeard
figures.why: King of Ironforge

figures.name: Muradin Bronzebeard
figures.why: Magni's brother, lost in Northrend

mentions: The Dark Iron dwarves of Blackrock Depths are the dwarves' bitter enemies

races.name: Night Elf
races.summary: An ancient people of Kalimdor who live in the forests and honor the moon goddess Elune.
races.history: Ten thousand years ago the night elves' magic drew the Burning Legion into the world, and the War of the Ancients that followed shattered the continent. They gave up arcane magic and lived apart for millennia. In the Third War they fought the Legion again and lost their immortality, and they have since grown the new World Tree, Teldrassil, off the coast of Darkshore.

figures.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
figures.why: High Priestess of Elune

figures.name: Fandral Staghelm
figures.why: Arch Druid who grew Teldrassil

figures.name: Malfurion Stormrage
figures.why: The first druid, asleep in the Emerald Dream

mentions: Night elves turn into a wisp when they die, which moves faster to the spirit healer
The Sentinels, the night elf army, guard Ashenvale against the Horde's loggers

races.name: Gnome
races.summary: Small, clever inventors from Dun Morogh, now living as guests of the dwarves in Ironforge.
races.history: The gnomes built Gnomeregan, a city of machines under Dun Morogh. When troggs rose from below, the gnomes flooded their own city with radiation to drive them out, a plan that killed many gnomes and failed. Mekgineer Thermaplugg, who betrayed his people, still rules the ruins.

figures.name: Gelbin Mekkatorque
figures.why: High Tinker of the gnomes

figures.name: Mekgineer Thermaplugg
figures.why: Traitor who rules the ruins of Gnomeregan

mentions: Gnomes are the race most tied to engineering
The Gnomeregan dungeon is the gnomes' fallen city, reached from Dun Morogh

races.name: Orc
races.summary: A proud warrior people from Draenor and the heart of the Horde.
races.history: The orcs were shamans on Draenor until Gul'dan's warlocks bound them to the Burning Legion. Driven by demon blood, they invaded Azeroth through the Dark Portal, lost the Second War and were kept in internment camps. Thrall freed them, broke the demons' hold and led the new Horde to Kalimdor, where they founded Durotar.

figures.name: Thrall
figures.why: Warchief of the Horde

figures.name: Grommash Hellscream
figures.why: Warsong chieftain who freed the orcs from the demons' blood curse by killing Mannoroth

mentions: Durotar is named after Durotan, Thrall's father
The Burning Blade cult still serves the Legion in the hills of Durotar

races.name: Undead
races.summary: The Forsaken: undead who broke free of the Lich King and now hold the ruins of Lordaeron.
races.history: The Scourge killed and raised the people of Lordaeron in the Third War. When the Lich King's power weakened, the banshee Sylvanas Windrunner and others regained their minds. They took the sewers under the ruined capital as their city and joined the Horde, though few in the Horde trust them.

facts.label: Capital
facts.value: The Undercity, under the ruins of Lordaeron

facts.label: Leader
facts.value: The Banshee Queen, Lady Sylvanas Windrunner

figures.name: Sylvanas Windrunner
figures.why: Queen of the Forsaken

figures.name: Varimathras
figures.why: Dreadlord who serves Sylvanas

mentions: The Royal Apothecary Society works on a new plague in the Undercity
The client names the race 'Scourge' in its files; the game shows it as Undead, and the Forsaken is its lore name

races.name: Tauren
races.summary: Huge, peaceful hunters of the plains who honor the Earth Mother.
races.history: The tauren once roamed Kalimdor as nomad tribes. Centaur raids nearly wiped them out until Thrall's orcs helped them, and High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof brought the tribes together in Mulgore and joined the Horde. Their druids and shamans keep the balance of nature.

figures.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
figures.why: High Chieftain of the tauren

figures.name: Hamuul Runetotem
figures.why: Arch druid of Thunder Bluff

mentions: The tauren are the Horde's druids in this era, with the night elves on the Alliance side
Thunder Bluff's mesas are joined by rope bridges and lifts

races.name: Troll
races.summary: The Darkspear tribe: jungle trolls who follow Vol'jin and fight for the Horde.
races.history: The Darkspear were driven out of Stranglethorn by other troll tribes. Thrall helped them escape the murlocs and the sea witch, and they followed him to Kalimdor. They settled the Echo Isles off Durotar until the witch doctor Zalazane took the isles over with his magic, so many now live in Sen'jin Village.

facts.label: Home
facts.value: Sen'jin Village and Orgrimmar, in Durotar

facts.label: Homeland
facts.value: Stranglethorn Vale, in the Eastern Kingdoms

figures.name: Vol'jin
figures.why: Leader of the Darkspear trolls

figures.name: Zalazane
figures.why: Witch doctor who took the Echo Isles

mentions: Trolls regenerate health faster than other races, even in combat
Other troll tribes (Gurubashi, Amani, Witherbark) are enemies of the Darkspear

races.name: High Order Skyborne
races.summary: One of the two paths of the Skyborne (shen'dorei), Forever's own race from Zephras Isle in Skywall. The High Order fights for the Alliance.
races.history: Per the game's own text, the High Order descends from the Highborne scholars of Eldre'Thalas. When the wind spirits vanished from Zephras Isle, they saw how much the Skyborne had depended on them, and they now send a new generation to Azeroth to recover lost arcane knowledge so their people can stand on their own.

facts.label: Home
facts.value: Zephras Isle, in Skywall (both Skyborne paths start there)

facts.label: Side
facts.value: Alliance; the Windshapers are the Horde path

figures.name: Elaadrin Evengale
figures.why: Supreme Magister of the High Order

figures.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
figures.why: Leader of Thendal Village, who gives new Skyborne their first tasks

mentions: The two Skyborne paths share the same island and first quests; the side is chosen with the path
The Skyborne race needs the Skyborne Heroic or Epic Pack (from the Outpost's Zephras Isle notes)
races.foreverNotes: A race of WoW Forever only: it is not in World of Warcraft Classic. These notes were written from the game's own description and the in-game data the Outpost has (the Zephras Isle notes and the creatures Forever showed), not from an outside source.

races.name: Windshaper Skyborne
races.summary: One of the two paths of the Skyborne (shen'dorei), Forever's own race from Zephras Isle in Skywall. The Windshapers fight for the Horde.
races.history: Per the game's own text, the Windshapers descend from the first shen'dorei high elves to receive the wind spirits' gift of elemental skysight. A new generation comes to Azeroth from Skywall to find out what became of their missing elemental mentors and to bring the wind spirits back.

facts.label: Home
facts.value: Zephras Isle, in Skywall (both Skyborne paths start there)

facts.label: Side
facts.value: Horde; the High Order is the Alliance path

figures.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
figures.why: Grand Skyseer of the Windshapers

figures.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
figures.why: Leader of Thendal Village, who gives new Skyborne their first tasks

mentions: The two Skyborne paths share the same island and first quests; the side is chosen with the path
The Skyborne race needs the Skyborne Heroic or Epic Pack (from the Outpost's Zephras Isle notes)
races.foreverNotes: A race of WoW Forever only: it is not in World of Warcraft Classic. These notes were written from the game's own description and the in-game data the Outpost has (the Zephras Isle notes and the creatures Forever showed), not from an outside source.
